Publisher: Rome: In domo generalitia; printed at the Polyglot Press of the Propaganda, 1899 (title page)
Publication Date: 1899 (title page, read directly; the host record says 1898)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1899); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item actacapitulorumg02domi, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-10 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (1,488,900) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1899, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: fair; the chapter headings are easy to find. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: The Dominican general chapters' own acts, chapter by chapter, 1304-1378. The chapter of 1304 at about OCR line 341 ('ANNO DOMINI . M. CCC. IIII.'), 1305 at about 777, 1306 at about 1202.
